note: The script asks for the hook text and the name supers (Nicole, Jalen, Cody, Ian), then the end card with its two lines. The other rows are captions only.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: Sunday dinner. At a family shelter.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “Sunday dinner. At a family shelter.” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top third.

mg.title: Nicole super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05 for 3 s, lower left: “Nicole Williams” / Mother
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 3 s. Lower left, a little lower than V3, above the captions. Type the second line <Mother> under the name.

mg.title: Jalen super
mg.cue: Name supers at 00:25 for 3 s: “Jalen Williams” / Oklahoma City Thunder, lower left
mg.use: Put it on at 00:25 for 3 s, lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Oklahoma City Thunder> under the name.

mg.title: Cody super
mg.cue: “Cody Williams” / Minnesota Timberwolves, lower right, only while Cody is in the frame
mg.use: Only while Cody is in the frame. Lower right, above the captions. Type the second line <Minnesota Timberwolves> under the name.

mg.title: Ian super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:47 for 2 s, lower left: “Ian Snyder” / CASS Client at Vista Colina Family Shelter
mg.use: Put it on at 00:47 for 2 s, lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <CASS Client at Vista Colina Family Shelter> under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry). The CASS name is typed in CASS navy until the logo file is added to endcards/cass/. Wording from the client file: cassaz.org.

text.name: CASS
lines: We're looking forward to having the Williams Brothers back for Sunday Dinner this fall!

mg.use: After Nicole's last line at 01:07. Let the CASS logo finish its animation first, then bring up the two lines, so they never overlap. Hold to the end (about 10 s).
